title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC ETF outflows $487M on Oct 7 — largest weekly withdrawal; $540M in leveraged liq wipeout.
BTC ~$82,700, testing $82K-$83K support; analyst warns $80K if broken.
Bitcoin.de halts trading — German BaFin rejects MiCA application.
Robinhood adds $25M BTC to balance sheet (corporate treasury).
Sep CPI due Oct 14 · PPI + retail sales Oct 15 — next macro catalysts.
